title: The Refillable Package
short_teaser: Some brands redesign packaging so the durable container remains while only the contents are replaced.
story: Some brands redesign packaging so the durable container remains while only the contents are replaced. Innovation can reduce waste by changing what is treated as disposable. Innovation is usually a chain of observations, tests, failures, adjustments, and connections. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
